effects.label: Freeze
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns are paused.The recipient will take 75% damage from incoming attacks.

bio: Six hundred years ago, an apocalyptic winter storm flowed south over nearly all of the Thursian Mountains, and it nearly destroyed every Orcish city north of the volcanic lowlands. It was during that storm that the Winterguard was founded – and it was Dathokal that they forged to stop it.
